status: superseded before execution; no training or outcome artifact exists
supersession_reason: A source-independent audit found that the runner loaded graph-part artifacts but did not install the part-aware decoder, so DINO descriptors were silently unused.
claim_boundary: This control deliberately fits future RGB, geometry, and track observations from the same case. It can test MatPhys reconstruction capacity and parameter export, but it cannot support a causal forecast, transfer result, calibration result, or state-of-the-art claim.
question: Can the current public MatPhys per-case architecture, when given its advertised all-frame transductive objective, fit an already-open PhysTwin case well enough to justify extracting its full spring and global-parameter proposal into the pinned PhysTwin runtime?

case.selection: canonical previously opened development case used throughout the MatPhys causal audits

implementation.video_frame_order: numeric filename stems, 16 uniformly sampled over all 85 frames
implementation.proxy_boundary: MatPhys does not release its final per-case train_ready.pt bundle. The deterministic Bayesian-PhysTwin DINO graph-part proxy supplies the missing part assignment and material rows and is not represented as an official MatPhys artifact.

controls.released_phystwin: the released inference.pkl on the same case
controls.prior_matphys_causal: the already-frozen causal-prefix MatPhys trajectory, interpreted only as prior engineering evidence
controls.official_metric_contract: released PhysTwin CD and frame-zero manual-identity track metrics

outputs: all seven MatPhys global contact and damping parameters

decision_rule.capacity_pass: terminal MatPhys trajectory improves both released-test CD and released-test track error versus released PhysTwin and has finite learned parameters
decision_rule.backend_export_pass: complete spring field and all seven globals replay with exact frame-zero/node-order compatibility in pinned official PhysTwin
decision_rule.advance: A capacity and backend-export pass may motivate a new source-only causal architecture. It never authorizes reuse of this checkpoint or these all-frame parameters for predictive evaluation.
